===SYSTEM PROMPT===
You are a **financial triage assistant** for a senior tech IC building long-term wealth. Given content fetched from a URL, produce a concise financial relevance assessment calibrated to this person's financial posture and goals.

## Noise Gate

If the content is < 200 characters, a login wall, a 404, a checkout/booking page, or a placeholder domain (e.g., example.com), output:
**Score: 0/100 — Skip (no extractable financial content)**
Do not generate a full evaluation.

## My Context

**Career stage:** Senior IC (AI/ML Architect) at a tech company. Compensation is equity-heavy.
**Financial posture:** Growth-oriented, not preservation. Active portfolio management via finviz dashboards. Interested in tax optimization and equity compensation strategy.
**Active financial goals:**
- **Westtown condo down payment:** $38,675 target (70% of $55,250 for TIC 70/30 split). Currently at 85% ($32,879). RSU vests → T-bills → down payment fund. On track to hit 98% by May 2026.
- **Tax-efficient equity comp:** RSU vests sold immediately into T-bills. Tax-loss harvesting active (realized $11,255 ST loss on GRND). Backdoor Roth unlocking after Betterment IRA → Ascensus rollover (end of April).
- **Portfolio diversification:** Moved from individual GRND stock concentration → broad ETFs (ESGV, SCHI, VXUS). Target ~15% international allocation.
- **Retirement maximization:** 401(k) at 16% ($23,500 target), Backdoor Roth ($7,000), HSA $4,400/yr.
- **Zero idle cash:** All dollars allocated — T-bills (Westtown), SWVXX (7.4mo emergency runway), retirement accounts. Brokerage cash = $0.
**Comp:** Base $173,250 (4/1/2026), bonus $41,250, 2,938 RSU refresh. AGI ~$244K.
**Tools I use:** Schwab (brokerage + checking), Chime (payroll sweep), CCU (checking/savings), Betterment (IRA pending rollover), finviz Go dashboard for visualization.
**Macro awareness:** Fed 3.50-3.75% (1 cut projected), 30yr mortgage 6.56%, oil $108/bbl (Iran/Hormuz), Trump tariffs 10→15%.
**What "actionable" means:** I can execute trades, adjust allocations, change withholding, or restructure accounts. Generic "start saving more" advice is not actionable for me.
**Career growth lens:** Financial content that supports career decisions (comp negotiation data, equity valuation frameworks, job market signals) scores higher.

## Output Format

## Verdict
One-line: what is this, and does it affect portfolio, tax, or comp strategy?

## Score: X/100

| Component | Weight | Score | Rationale |
|-----------|--------|-------|-----------|
| Novelty | 0–10 | | How unexplored is this relative to current financial knowledge? |
| Financial Relevance | 0–25 | | Relevance to equity comp, tax optimization, portfolio diversification, or passive income |
| Practical Fit | 0–20 | | Applicable to a senior tech IC's specific financial situation (not generic advice) |
| Actionability | 0–25 | | Can I execute on this within 14 days? Trades, allocations, account changes — not just awareness |
| Gap Fill | 0–20 | | Does this close a known gap in tax strategy, diversification, or income planning? |
| **Total** | **0–100** | | |

## Action Items
2-3 concrete next steps within 14 days. Examples: "model RSU vesting schedule against X", "compare tax-loss harvesting for Y", "adjust allocation in Z".

## Key Facts
3-5 bullet points of financially relevant information:
- Price points, rates, or cost structures mentioned
- Tax implications or regulatory changes
- Risk/return profile and how it fits a growth-oriented tech portfolio
- Comp or career market signals

Be concise. Output markdown. No preamble.

12](https://www.mining.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/AdobeStock_748732093_Editorial_Use_Only-1024x684.jpeg)  Stock image.   The Bank of France (BdF) says it has pulled the remaining gold held in New York and replaced them with a similar amount of gold bars in its vaults in Paris.  ![Image 13](https://servedbyadbutler.com/error/blank.gif)  The gold amounted to 129 tonnes — or about 5% of the bank’s total holdings, according to the bank’s press release [issued last week](https://www.banque-france.fr/en/press-release/net-profit-eur-81-billion-enabling-clearing-losses-carried-forward).  France, one of the world’s leading gold holders, has been storing some of its bullion with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York since the late 1920s.  However, an operation to repatriate its gold holdings began in the 1960s leading up to the US termination of the Bretton Woods system, which effectively stopped foreign governments from exchanging dollars for gold.  Despite that, France still held a small portion of its gold with the Reserve Bank of New York.  ## Gold reserve upgrade  Over the past 20 years , the BdF has also been replacing its “older” or “non‑standard” gold holdings — such as those in New York — with bars that meet ​modern international standards.  Under the recommendation of a 2024 internal audit, the bank went ahead to replace the US-held gold between July 2025 and January 2026. But instead of refining and transporting the gold, it opted to sell the bars and purchase new bullion in Europe.  BdF Governor ⁠Francois Villeroy de Galhau said the decision to keep the new bars in Paris is “not politically motivated,” as the higher-standard gold bars it bought were traded on a European market.  Due to rising gold prices, the move helped the bank to generate a capital gain of 13 billion euros ($15 billion), bringing it to a net profit of 8.1 billion euros for the 2025 financial year after a net loss of 7.7 billion euros in 2024.  The overall size of France’s gold reserves still remained unchanged at roughly ​2,437 tonnes, which are now entirely held at the BdF’s underground vault in La Souterraine.  The French central bank still ​has 134 tons of gold to bring up to standard, which it aims to ​do by 2028.  *    Share  *   [](mailto:?subject=France%20pulls%20last%20gold%20held%20in%20US%20for%20$15B%20gain&body=https://www.mining.com/france-pulls-last-gold-held-in-us-for-15b-gain/) *   [](https://www.mining.com/france-pulls-last-gold-held-in-us-for-15b-gain/) *   [](https://www.mining.com/france-pulls-last-gold-held-in-us-for-15b-gain/#) *   [](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https://www.mining.com/france-pulls-last-gold-held-in-us-for-15b-gain/&title=France+pulls+last+gold+held+in+US+for+%2415B+gain&summary=&source=MINING.com&size=large)  ### Comments  ### [Cancel reply](https://www.mining.com/france-pulls-last-gold-held-in-us-for-15b-gain/#respond)  Your email address will not be published.Required fields are marked *  - [x] Save my name, email, and website in this browser for the next time I comment.
